title: The Entry

launchpad.outcome: Place the planned entry at the PIL and execute only after the retest, never by chasing.
launchpad.missionQuestion: Did my execution opportunity actually arrive?

slides.heading: The entry is the execution point created by the model
slides.punch: Not “where I think price should go”.

slides.headline: Full sequence, then the entry
slides.line: Confirm each step as price earns it. A shiny button may appear. 👀

slides.quote: Price moving without you doesn’t create a new rule. Your plan was the retest.

slides.modelAnswer: A confirmed PIL, indication, correction and continuation, then price returning to the PIL for the first retest. The entry is at the PIL, created by the model.

remember: The entry is the execution point the model created.
